items.headline: Multiple analysts raise Zscaler (ZS) price targets and reiterate bullish ratings
KeyBanc Capital Markets raises Zscaler price target from $185 to $210, maintaining Overweight rating
Stifel Nicolaus raises Zscaler price target to $200 and maintains Buy rating
Mizuho boosts Zscaler price target to $210 with Outperform rating
Cantor Fitzgerald assigns Overweight rating to Zscaler (ZS)
